name: player game prop line keeps one row per week when a book lists the same player twice (executed-result parity)
description: Widening the markets CTE from one week to the whole requested week list only works if the CTE is unique per (pid, year, week); it is not. Production holds 49 (pid, nfl_week_id, market_type) groups since 2023 carrying two FanDuel CLOSE OVER selections, so an uncorrelated or undeduplicated CTE fans a week cell into one row per listing. Seed week 1 twice for one player -- an earlier listing at 240.5 and a later one at 235.5 -- plus a single week-2 listing. The view must return exactly two rows, and week 1 must carry the LATER observation, which is the dedupe policy: newest selection_observed_at wins, ties broken on source_market_id.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1, 2)), "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9_markets" as (select "source_id", "source_market_id", "time_type", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "prop_markets_index" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "prop_markets_index"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "prop_markets_index"."season_year" and nfl_games.nfl_week_id in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') where "market_type" = 'GAME_PASSING_YARDS' and "time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" in (2023) and "source_id" = 'FANDUEL'), "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9" as (select distinct on ("pms"."selection_pid", "m"."year", "m"."week") pms.selection_pid, pms.selection_metric_line, "m"."year", "m"."week" from "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9_markets" as "m" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER') order by "pms"."selection_pid" asc, "m"."year" asc, "m"."week" asc, "pms"."observed_at" desc, "m"."source_market_id" asc), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1', '2023_REG_WEEK_2') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9"."selection_metric_line" AS "game_prop_line_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9" on "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9"."selection_pid" = "player"."pid" and t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9.year = player_years_weeks.year and t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t82b774e664d2d9bb7d54fbd433586eb9"."selection_metric_line", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
